title: Home page hero variants
description: data/hero.json: the headline, subhead and art variants of the blowhorn.ai home page hero, and which of them rotate. Every rotating variant is rendered into the static HTML and layouts/_partials/hero-rotation-head.html shows one at page load; the default is what no-JS visitors, crawlers and social previews get. See docs/hero-variants.md.

default.description: Id of the variant no-JS visitors see, and that the meta, Open Graph and JSON-LD descriptions are built from. Must be one of rotation (the build fails otherwise).

rotation.description: Ids of the variants that rotate, in order: the hero shown is rotation[floor(now / interval) % length], with the interval from params.hero_rotation.interval_seconds in hugo.toml. Omit to rotate every variant. Variants not listed stay in the file for later.

variants.description: Every variant. Only those listed in rotation are shown.

id.description: URL-safe id, used in ?hero=<id>, data-hero and data-hero-only.

headline.description: The h1. Plain text, hyphens never em dashes.

subhead.description: The paragraph under the h1. Plain text, hyphens never em dashes.

art.description: The illustration beside the copy, a partial in layouts/_partials/hero-art/: stage is Major Blowhorn barking into your own Chrome, fan is one message fanning out to every platform. Defaults to stage.

differentiators.description: Numbers of the claims this copy rests on in Blowhorn's canonical differentiators list. Copy may only state what those claims allow.

note.description: Why this variant exists, for reviewers. Not rendered.
